name: evm-wallet
title: EVM Wallet
description: A per-chat EVM wallet driven by /wallet slash commands: generates a FRESH random account for every chat (no imports — private keys never travel through the chat), EIP-55 checksum addresses, native + ERC-20 balances, gas price, multi-network JSON-RPC over public endpoints (Ethereum, Sepolia, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, OP Mainnet + testnets), and EIP-155 signed transfers with a mandatory two-step confirmation (/wallet send shows the FULL transaction summary, /wallet confirm signs and broadcasts, /wallet cancel discards). Testnet by default (Sepolia). Sample/demo quality — small amounts only.
